title: Culinary Techniques: Tuna Salad, Crudo, and Nigiri Sushi Preparation
description: This video provides a multi-topic guide to preparing various dishes, including a tuna salad recipe, a simple three-ingredient caprese salad with cantaloupe crudo, and detailed instructions on knife skills and assembling nigiri sushi.
summary: The video segments cover several distinct food preparation processes. One section details the preparation of tuna salad, instructing the viewer to finely mash tuna and mix it with diced gherkins and a creamy, mayo-based dressing, seasoning to taste. Another segment focuses on preparing a cantaloupe crudo, advising the use of heirloom tomatoes and mozzarella, and layering ingredients simply for a three-ingredient caprese salad. The core segment focuses on sushi preparation, where the audio instructs viewers on proper knife skills—slicing fish against the grain using a "heel to tip" technique. It then transitions to handling cooked rice, advising viewers to break it up, season it with sushi vinegar, and shape it into a light ball before assembling the nigiri. Finally, the instructions guide the viewer on forming fish balls by placing fish on top of the rice and using a damp towel to shape the final product.

title: A Collection of Quick & Creamy Recipes: Garlic Pasta, Pan con Tomato, and Baking

The video features instructions for several distinct recipes.
